newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain to respond to Qatar's border claims Monday.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain to respond to Qatar's border claims Monday.

text.p: Bahrain will on Monday submit a memorandum to the International Court of Justice (ICJ) over a territorial dispute with Qatar, a government official said.
"Bahrain will submit its memorandum to the court today," the official said, but gave no details.
Foreign Minister Sheikh Mohammad bin Mubarak al-Khalifa said on Saturday the memorandum contains Bahrain's response "to claims by Qatar that affect (Bahrain's) sovereignty and territorial integrity."
Qatar and Bahrain are locked in a dispute over a number of barren but potentially oil and gas-rich islands, including Hawar islands, sandbanks and reefs controlled by Bahrain since the 1930s.
Bahrain has repeatedly asked Qatar to withdraw the case it had taken to the court at The Hague and accept Saudi mediation.
Qatar says it will only withdraw the case from the world court if Saudi Arabia's mediation succeeded.
Doha unilaterally asked the World Court in 1991 to settle the problem. The court decided in January it had jurisdiction and is expected to produce a verdict by the end of 1996.
